profile.org_note: No formal region or segment layer is published: the company's own releases and office list show about 17 local divisions, each under a Division President (or General Manager), reporting to CEO Steve Alloy and the Reston corporate team; the only regional title on record is Eric Marks, Regional President over Florida (2024 release), and the acquired Holiday Builders runs as its own Florida subsidiary under Bruce Assam. Land deals start in division land teams (Directors / VPs of Land) and go to a Reston corporate land department for review: a 2025 company job posting has corporate land staff reviewing division land acquisitions and budgets, and job-board listings seen in search results (not opened) have Directors of Land Acquisition reporting to a Senior Vice President of Land Acquisition (name not public); CEO Steve Alloy fronts big land and M&A deals, CFO Randy Kotler covers financing and treasury, and large approvals go to parent Daiwa House.
profile.email_pattern: lastname + first and middle initials @stanleymartin.com (e.g. piedrahitajm@stanleymartin.com); single published example
profile.summary: Builder 100 #18 (5,320 closings in 2025, about $2.4B revenue) and Daiwa House's largest US homebuilder. It mainly sells entry-level and first-time move-up homes across VA, MD, WV, the Carolinas, GA and FL. Since Sept 2025 it has bought Windsor Homes' assets (about 2,100 NC lots), United Homes Group (closed 2026-05-04, $221M EV, about 1,192 closings) and Holiday Builders (closed late July 2026, about 1,050 closings, ~10,600 FL lots). That should push it toward about 7,500+ annual closings across 19+ metros. The core company is land-heavy by choice, with in-house entitlement and development and a $700M data-center land sale in 2025. The acquired businesses (UHG ~96% optioned, using land banks and a Kennedy Lewis term loan that was repaid at closing) bring option-based land books, which is the opening for a land banker.

people.name: Steve Alloy
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer, Stanley Martin Homes; CEO, Stanley Martin Holdings, LLC; Executive Chairman, Daiwa House USA Holdings, Inc.
people.prior_role: With the company since 1991; president since 1998
people.source_title: Stanley Martin Homes to Acquire Holiday Builders (company release)
people.note: Title 'President and Chief Executive Officer' in Stanley Martin's own 2026-05-04 and 2026-07-20 releases. Daiwa House Integrated Report 2026 (CEO message, p.41: https://www.daiwahouse.com/English/ir/ar/pdf/daiwahouse_IR2026E_all.pdf) lists him as CEO, Stanley Martin Holdings, LLC and Executive Chairman, Daiwa House USA Holdings, Inc., so he is also the senior Daiwa executive over its US builders (Stanley Martin, Trumark, CastleRock). Son of co-founder Martin Alloy; president since 1998; co-founder of Duball (Virginia Business, 2026-08-30). He is the public face of every acquisition (Windsor, United Homes Group, Holiday Builders) and of the land-heavy strategy (Devlin Road tract sold to Amazon Data Services for ~$700M, Oct 2025).
